formulas.exact_hit_rate: fraction of runs classified as exact_recurrence
formulas.false_positive_rate: fraction of adversarial control runs incorrectly classified as exact_recurrence
formulas.modulus_consistency_score: mean fraction of moduli in {2,3,5,7,11,25} on which the candidate recurrence still holds
formulas.selector_complexity: small integer complexity proxy derived from the selector template class
formulas.blocker_tags: subset of the blocker taxonomy defined below

blocker_taxonomy.rational_triviality: positive hit explained by the rational arithmetic-progression baseline
blocker_taxonomy.word_value_confusion: symbolic or word-level evidence mislabeled as a value recurrence
blocker_taxonomy.set_sequence_confusion: unordered Beatty-set facts mislabeled as ordered subsequence facts
blocker_taxonomy.post_selection_leakage: zero-density or tuned selector without an infinite structural certificate
